description: This file defines the EmailService interface for the Book Project, specifying methods for sending emails and related utilities.

classes.name: EmailService
classes.description: Interface defining email-related functionalities such as sending messages and processing email addresses.

methods.name: sendSimpleMessage
methods.description: Sends a basic email message with specified sender, recipient, and message body.

methods.name: sendMessageUsingThymeleafTemplate
methods.description: Sends an email using a Thymeleaf template, with parameters for recipient, subject, and template model; may throw MessagingException.

methods.name: getUsernameFromEmail
methods.description: Default method that extracts and returns the username part of an email address.
